title.en: Recognizing the Former Members of the HUKBALAHAP Under Luis M. Taruc Who Fought the Japanese in World War II as Elements of the Underground Forces in the Philippines During World War II, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The former members of the Hukbo ng Bayan Laban sa Hapon (HUKBALAHAP) who actually
fought the Japanese at any time during the period from 1941 to 1945 under Luis M. Taruc are hereby
recognized officially as elements of the underground forces of the Commonwealth Government of the
Philippines during World War II.

The Philippine Veterans Affairs Office shall make a listing of these members of the
HUKBALAHAP who fought the Japanese during World War II, in coordination with the existing agencies

The Philippine Veterans Affairs Office shall process the said claim in coordination with the
existing agencies concerned. It shall establish such rules and regulations necessary to establish the service
record of these members, in coordination with the organizers, staff, or commanders of the HUKBALAHAP
under Luis M. Taruc.

Agencies implementing the pertinent laws on veterans benefits are hereby enjoined to receive,
process, adjudicate and grant, if warranted, the claims of HUKBALAHAP members or their dependents for
hospitalization and scholarship, notwithstanding any previous deadlines established to the contrary.

Such provisions of existing laws, decrees, rules or regulations inconsistent with the provisions of
the Decree, are hereby modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
